rules.title: Tasa de errores alta hacia fx-course-service

annotations.summary: Más del 5% de las llamadas de fx-catalog-service a fx-course-service fallan o son rechazadas por el circuit breaker

model.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_calls_seconds_count{application="fx-catalog-service",name="courseService",kind="failed"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_not_permitted_calls_total{application="fx-catalog-service",name="courseService"}[1m])) or vector(0))) / (((sum(rate(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_calls_seconds_count{application="fx-catalog-service",name="courseService",kind="failed"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_not_permitted_calls_total{application="fx-catalog-service",name="courseService"}[1m])) or vector(0))) + (sum(rate(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_calls_seconds_count{application="fx-catalog-service",name="courseService",kind="successful"}[1m])) or vector(0)))
